entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, Isaac. I... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed, I really hope you can help me.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I'll do my best to help. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-881-045. It's for a helmet I bought. It's just... the color is completely wrong in person. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money back.
Okay, I'm pulling up order VF-881-045 now. I see the Pro-Safety helmet here. It looks like this was delivered about 80 days ago, is that correct?

Oh, has it been that long? I've just had a lot going on. The box is still unopened, I never even took it out. My main concern is always safety, but this just wasn't what I expected. I was really counting on being able to return it.
I understand completely. Let me just take a quick look at our return policy for you... one moment.
Alright, I've checked. It looks like you're in luck. Our policy states that items like this helmet can be returned within 90 days of delivery, as long as they're in original condition.
Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried. Thank you, Isaac. That's a huge relief.

Of course. Since the box is unopened and you're well within the timeframe, I'm happy to approve this return for you. I've just emailed a prepaid shipping label to the address on file. Just attach that to the box and drop it off. You'll receive a full refund once it arrives back at our warehouse.
You've been a great help. I really appreciate you making this so easy.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
